# Nova API — /api/metrics

The operations Nova tags `public` under `/api/metrics`. Generated from `reference-src/nova-openapi.json`.

## DELETE /api/metrics/\{id\}

Operation id `metric_definitions_delete`: in Python `client.call("metric_definitions_delete", …)`, on the command line `stardelt api metric_definitions_delete`.

`DELETE /api/metrics/{id}` — `204`; `404` when the id is not a row.

Remove one metric definition; it was stored, never executed. Only the owner group of its table and administrators may delete it.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | integer | Yes | The metric definition's id |

**Responses**

| Code | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `204` | Deleted |
| `401` | Not signed in |
| `403` | Only the owner group and administrators may delete a metric definition |
| `404` | No such metric definition, or the id is not a number |
| `502` | The catalog is not reachable or did not answer |
| `503` | The state store is not configured |
